name: 28360 · Lumberton, NC
findings: ZIP 28360 (Lumberton) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28360 (Lumberton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28360 (Lumberton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28360 (Lumberton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
